to.character_compatibility_rationale: Dynavision_v10 is specifically designed for consistent character rendering and shows superior identity preservation capabilities. Better facial feature consistency, reduced multi-face generation, stronger adherence to character specifications.
to.vae_status: baked - no separate VAE node required

checkpoint_change.change_rationale: RealvisxlV50 checkpoint produces fundamental incompatibility with Alya character type: inconsistent facial features (1-3 faces per frame), visual artifacts (haze, banding, texture collapse), inability to maintain stable single-character identity. Dynavision checkpoint recommended as alternative with proven character consistency capabilities.

identity_strategy.strategy_description: Redundant identity preservation combining reference node and IP-Adapter for maximum identity stability

components.purpose: Primary structure preservation - maintains character silhouette and body proportions
components.change_rationale: Increased from 0.6 to 0.85 for maximum identity lock strength with dynavision checkpoint

components.purpose: Facial feature extraction and preservation - complements reference node with face-specific identity lock
components.configuration: IPAdapterAdvanced node with noise 0.0, connect to same reference image as reference node

identity_strategy.combined_effect: Dual identity lock: reference node preserves overall character structure at 0.85 weight, IP-Adapter preserves facial features at 0.8 weight. Redundant mechanisms ensure identity stability even if one component underperforms.

reference_specifications: Higher quality source image with clear facial feature definition
Better lit to provide stable reference signal
Cropped to emphasize face for stronger identity lock
Tested with dynavision checkpoint before workflow submission

identity_strategy.identity_strength_target: Maximum - 95%+ facial feature consistency, zero face count variation, stable single-character identity across all frames

workflow_parameter_changes.parameter_summary: All parameters revised for stronger identity lock and artifact reduction with dynavision checkpoint

changes.rationale: Reduced to maintain stronger adherence to reference image and reduce identity drift. Lower denoising preserves more reference structure while still allowing sufficient generation flexibility.
Increased for stronger prompt adherence and identity control. Higher CFG helps enforce strict character specification and negative constraints against multi-face generation.
Significantly increased for maximum identity lock strength. Combined with IP-Adapter, creates dual identity preservation mechanism.
Upgraded for improved generation quality and stability. SDE variant shows better performance with character consistency workflows.
Changed for better noise schedule distribution with dynavision checkpoint. Exponential scheduler shows improved detail preservation.
Increased for improved quality and artifact reduction. Additional steps help eliminate haze and banding issues.
New component for dual identity lock. FaceID Plus provides facial feature extraction that complements reference node approach.

prompt_identity_guidance_update.revised_positive_prompt_guidance: Professional photograph of Alya, 25-year-old woman with defined consistent facial features: oval face shape, straight nose, almond-shaped brown eyes, medium-length auburn hair, natural makeup. Wearing simple dark clothing. Maintains exact same facial structure and features across all frames. Single subject only, no additional people.
prompt_identity_guidance_update.revised_negative_prompt_guidance: multiple people, extra faces, inconsistent facial features, changing face shape, varying hair color, different eye color, model degradation, haze, banding, texture collapse, blurry, low quality, duplicate subjects, background characters
prompt_identity_guidance_update.identity_preservation_requirements: Strict single-character identity lock required. Must maintain: (1) Consistent facial geometry across all frames, (2) Stable hair color and style, (3) Unchanging eye color and shape, (4) Uniform skin tone, (5) Same body proportions and clothing. Zero tolerance for face count variation or identity drift.

consistency_targets.facial_features: 95%+ similarity across all frames - exact facial geometry preservation
consistency_targets.clothing_style: 95%+ consistency - no wardrobe changes within shot
consistency_targets.overall_appearance: 90%+ composite identity match - recognizable as same character

prompt_identity_guidance_update.checkpoint_specific_considerations: Dynavision checkpoint requires stronger negative prompting for multi-subject prevention. Character specification must explicitly exclude variations that this checkpoint might introduce. Reference images should emphasize the stable facial features most resistant to checkpoint-induced variation.

risk_assessment.rollback_plan: If dynavision checkpoint or IP-Adapter implementation fails: (1) Revert to realvisxl checkpoint, (2) Remove IP-Adapter node, (3) Restore original parameters, (4) Re-evaluate with Character Director for alternative approach, (5) Consider model training or workflow redesign if fundamental incompatibility confirmed.
